messages:
anna: Heads up — the Python starter sample in the onboarding docs has a broken link and an async snippet that doesn't match the current SDK API.

anna: Steps I hit: 1) Open https://docs.redwood.ai/python/starter  2) click 'Sample app'  3) the 'auth' section points to https://docs.redwood.ai/python/auth-old.md (404)

anna: The async example also uses the old sync client. Copy/paste fails with an AttributeError.

mike: @anna thanks — can you paste the snippet and which SDK version you're on?

anna: Sure — snippet straight from the page:
```python
from redwood import Client

async def gen():
    client = Client()
    await client.generate("hello")
```
It raises: AttributeError: 'Client' object has no attribute 'generate'

jordan: That looks like the pre-1.0 sync API. New async usage is `from redwood.async_sdk import AsyncClient` and method names are different (e.g., `await client.chat(...)`). Looks like docs drifted during the v0.9 -> v1.0 rename.

sara: Reproduced locally with redwood-python==1.2.3 — broken link + snippet mismatch confirmed. Also the retry example in the same page mentions `retries=3` in a call signature that doesn't exist anymore; we now configure retries via `RetryPolicy`.

mike: I'll open a docs issue and a quick PR to fix the snippet and update the link. @docs-team can someone confirm the canonical link we should point to for service-account auth?

ci-bot: Issue #4127 created by @mike - "python starter sample: broken auth link and async snippet mismatch"

mike: Putting a small PR up that swaps to AsyncClient, fixes the import, and updates the auth link to /python/auth#service-account. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987

anna: Thanks! A couple extra asks: 1) add a short note about retry defaults (people assume `retries=3`), and 2) include type hints for the credentials dict so static typing warns users before runtime.

jordan: Good call. I'll add a TypedDict example and a comment about explicitly calling `await client.aclose()` for the async client in the PR.

sara: One more gotcha — if people copy the old auth flow they hit a 401 because the service-account flow now requires an `audience` header. Please add that to the auth section.

mike: Great. Assigning @jordan for code review and @anna for a quick UX/doc sanity check. Merging after CI passes. :thumbsup:

anna: Awesome, thanks everyone :rocket:
